The event feedback survey shown one question at a time, for respondents on a phone. surveyframe declares the analysis in advance (Frequencies and percentages) and reports it in APA 7.

## In SurveyStudio

In RStudio, open the Addins menu, choose **surveyframe: Try a demo** and pick `conversational_survey`. The study opens on the Design screen. Plan shows each research question with its method and decision rule, Analyse runs them as declared, and Report writes the APA 7 report.

## In R

```r
d <- sframe_demo("conversational_survey")
results <- run_analysis_plan(d$responses, d$instrument)
render_report(d$instrument, d$responses)
```

## What the report gives

| Research question | Method | What the report gives |
|---|---|---|
| Who came to the event? | Frequencies and percentages | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |

The demo's data is simulated, so the site shows no numbers. Run it in SurveyStudio or R to see the results, each marked as demonstration data.
